verdict.rationale: Mercury Command supports bulk GL code assignment and categorization rules, and invoicing can bill many customers programmatically, showing some bulk-operation capability today. However, the full accounting API and MCP layer that would enable comprehensive AI-driven bulk operations are explicitly described as forthcoming, not yet available (probes confirm no live API/OpenAPI spec exists). Missing for 10: a shipped, documented API/MCP layer enabling arbitrary bulk operations, independent hands-on verification of bulk actions at scale.
